title: The role of inferior parietal lobule in emotion dysregulation in bipolar disorder
title_zh: 下顶叶在双相情感障碍情绪失调中的作用
abstract: Emotion dysregulation is a core feature of bipolar disorder (BD), with detrimental impacts on symptoms and functioning. The inferior parietal lobule (IPL) is a region consistently implicated in neurocircuit models of emotion regulation, yet the specific role of the IPL in emotion regulation generally, and emotion regulation in BD specifically, has been largely unexamined and unexplained. In this review, we attempt to better elucidate the role of the IPL in emotion regulation by examining normative evidence from healthy samples for IPL function in emotion regulation. We examine the specific role of the IPL in studies of emotion regulation generally, and in each of the subprocesses supporting emotion regulation - attentional deployment, cognitive change, and response modulation. We then review evidence for IPL functional and structural deficits in BD, in order to gain insights into the role of the IPL in emotion dysregulation in BD, and relevance for more precise development of interventions to improve emotion regulation in BD.
abstract_zh: 情绪失调是双相情感障碍（BD）的核心特征，对症状和功能产生不利影响。下顶叶（IPL）在情绪调节的神经回路模型中始终被认为是重要区域，但IPL在一般情绪调节以及BD中特定情绪调节中的具体作用尚未得到充分研究和解释。在本综述中，我们通过考察健康样本中IPL在情绪调节中的功能性证据，尝试更好地阐明IPL在情绪调节中的作用。我们检视IPL在情绪调节研究中的具体角色，以及支持情绪调节的各个子过程——注意力部署、认知改变和反应调节。随后，我们回顾IPL在BD中的功能和结构缺陷证据，以期深入了解IPL在BD情绪失调中的作用，并为更精准地开发改善BD情绪调节的干预措施提供参考。
